2027-01-18.title: Monday of the Second Week in Ordinary Time
readings: He learned obedience through what he suffered
You are a priest for ever, in the line of Melchizedek
2027-01-18.alt: Weekday of Ordinary Time, Week 2 (Year I). Liturgical colour: green. Week of Prayer for Christian Unity (18–25 January).
2027-01-18.verse: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and the wine is lost, and so are the skins; but one puts new wine into fresh wineskins.”
theo: Hebrews begins its great teaching on Christ the High Priest. Every high priest is chosen from among mortals to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins, and “is able to deal gently with the ignorant and wayward, since he himself is subject to weakness.” Christ did not appoint himself; the Father said: “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.” And he learned his priesthood in suffering: “In the days of his flesh, Jesus offered up prayers and supplications, with loud cries and tears… Although he was a Son, he learned obedience through what he suffered.”

In the Gospel people ask why Jesus' disciples do not fast. He answers with images of joy and newness: wedding guests do not fast while the bridegroom is with them; no one sews new cloth on an old garment; “one puts new wine into fresh wineskins.” Christ brings something new that needs new hearts. Today the Week of Prayer for Christian Unity begins: divisions among Christians are old wineskins that cannot hold the new wine of Christ's love. We pray, as Jesus did, “that they may all be one.”
outline: Ask: what happens when new wine goes into old skins?
Christ's priestly prayer in his suffering.
Christ needs renewed hearts and a united Church.
live: Each day this week pray the Our Father for the unity of Christians.
Let go of one old habit of thinking that resists Christ.
2027-01-18.prayer: Lord Jesus, High Priest who learned obedience through suffering, you pour new wine into our lives. Make our hearts new wineskins, and during this week of prayer make all Christians one, as you and the Father are one. Amen.
altar: At the altar Christ the eternal Priest offers himself. The cup of new wine is his Blood of the new covenant, which makes us one.

quick: Christ the High Priest learned obedience through suffering.
While the Bridegroom is present, his friends rejoice.
2027-01-18.action: Pray the Our Father daily this week for Christian unity.
2027-01-18.question: Is my heart a fresh wineskin for Christ's new wine?

family.explain: Jesus said: you cannot put new juice into an old dry bottle; it will burst! Jesus brings something new, and we need new hearts.
family.intention: We pray that all Christians may be one family.
family.ask: Ask: “Do we know Christians of other churches? Let us pray for them.”

illus: In Thiruvananthapuram, Catholic, Orthodox, Marthoma and CSI youth groups began cleaning a public beach together each January during the unity week. A girl said: we cannot yet share one altar, but we can share one broom and one prayer, and Jesus is pleased.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, eternal High Priest, you pour new wine into our lives. Make us new and make us one. Amen.
share: Jesus offered prayers with loud cries and tears (Hebrews 5:7). How do I pray in my suffering?
The wedding guests cannot fast while the bridegroom is with them (Mark 2:19). Do I live with Christian joy?
New wine into fresh wineskins (Mark 2:22). What must be renewed in me?
interc: For the unity of all Christians.
For priests, that they may deal gently with the weak.
For those suffering, that they may unite their cries with Christ's.
For a renewal of joy in the Church.
For our group, that we may become new wineskins.
pm.close: Father, your Son prayed that all may be one. Renew our hearts and heal the divisions among Christians. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Hebrews shows us Christ as our High Priest. Every priest is chosen from among people and can deal gently with the weak, because he too is weak. Christ did not make himself a priest; the Father said: you are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.

In the days of his flesh, Jesus offered up prayers and supplications, with loud cries and tears, and although he was a Son, he learned obedience through what he suffered (Hebrews 5:7–8). Our High Priest knows our tears from inside.

In the Gospel people ask why his disciples do not fast. Jesus says the wedding guests cannot fast while the bridegroom is with them. And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; one puts new wine into fresh wineskins (Mark 2:22). Jesus brings something new that needs new hearts.
Today the Week of Prayer for Christian Unity begins. Our divisions are old wineskins. Let us pray with Jesus, that they may all be one, and let us become new wineskins ourselves. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus said you cannot pour new juice into an old cracked bottle. Jesus wants to give us new, happy hearts!

intro: The suffering High Priest, the joy of the Bridegroom, the call to newness and unity.

q: For he did not despise or abhor the affliction of the afflicted; he did not hide his face from me, but heard when I cried to him.
In the days of his flesh, Jesus offered up prayers and supplications, with loud cries and tears, to the one who was able to save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverent submission.
points.apply: Bring your tears to God honestly in prayer.

q: The days are surely coming, says the LORD, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and the wine is lost, and so are the skins; but one puts new wine into fresh wineskins.”
points.apply: Let go of one old habit that resists Christ.

sub: So that the world may believe.
q: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king over them all. Never again shall they be two nations, and never again shall they be divided into two kingdoms.
that they may all be one. As you, Father, are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
points.apply: Pray daily this week for Christian unity.

concl: Christ is the eternal High Priest who brings new wine.
Let us become new wineskins, united in him.
2027-01-18.resolve: Do one act of friendship with Christians of another Church during this week.
